Name: q.bellwether.blastmask
Summary: A thief takes the old woman's bomb bag on the road north on the first night. Be standing there when he does.

Name: q.bellwether.sleepless
Summary: The same thief sells what he took. Catch him at the shop counter after midnight and buy it back.

Name: q.bellwether.postman
Summary: The postman keeps to his schedule until the last day, when he cannot make himself leave. Run it for him.

Name: q.bellwether.bandleader
Summary: The bandleader drills an empty square every morning. Fall in behind him.

Name: q.bellwether.altar
Summary: A woman has been waiting at an empty altar since the carnival was announced. Ask her who for.

Name: q.bellwether.couple
Summary: Carry the letters, find the man in hiding, and get the two of them into the same room before the last dawn.

Name: q.bellwether.fountain
Summary: The fountain spirit has come apart. Gather the pieces loose in the town and carry them back.

Name: q.bellwether.clocktower
Summary: The tower opens on the last night. Be at the top of it when it does.

Name: q.mirefen.witch
Summary: The witch's sister has gone looking for mushrooms and not come back. Go and get both.

Name: q.mirefen.spiders
DisplayName: The Gold in the Spider House
Summary: Thirty gold spiders in the house at the swamp's edge, and a curse that lifts when the last one is out.

Name: q.mirefen.monkey
Summary: A monkey is being blamed for the poisoned water. Hear it out before the guards do anything about it.

Name: q.mirefen.tour
Summary: The tour runs whether or not the water is fit to run it through. Shoot every target on the way past.

Name: q.mirefen.gatemerchant
Summary: A merchant is pressed into the rocks by the swamp gate, waiting for a soldier to look elsewhere.

Name: q.outskirts.hare
Summary: The man in the field wants proof of something nobody believes in, and will trade for it.

Name: q.outskirts.hole
Summary: The story about the hole in the ground turns out to be true. Go down it.

Name: q.outskirts.storms
DisplayName: The Spring That Only Runs in Rain
Summary: There is a spring on the road that only runs in bad weather, and a song that makes bad weather.

Name: q.frostcrown.elder
Summary: The village is burying its elder in weather that will not break. Play for him on the road.

Name: q.frostcrown.frogs
Summary: Five frogs scattered across the whole map, and a conductor who has been waiting for all of them.

Name: q.frostcrown.child
Summary: The elder's son will not sleep and will not be quiet. There is a lullaby for that, half-remembered.

Name: q.thaw.ranch.night
DisplayName: The Night the Herd Was Taken
Summary: Something comes for the herd on the second night. The younger sister has been telling everyone for days.

Name: q.thaw.ranch.race
Summary: Beat the elder sister across the ranch, and she will talk about the brother who left for the carnival.

Name: q.thaw.dancer
Summary: A ghost on a stone in the fields at midnight, still dancing, with nobody left to teach.

Name: q.thaw.barrow
Summary: The captain in the barrow will not stand down for anyone who has not played him to sleep first.

Name: q.tidebreak.guitarist
Summary: A musician washed up on the beach, still trying to get back to his band. Play for him.

Name: q.tidebreak.eggs
Summary: Seven eggs scattered between the pirates' hold and the reef, and a tank at the lab to hatch them in.

Name: q.tidebreak.band
Summary: The band has not played since their guitarist drowned, and the carnival is in three days.

Name: q.ashen.watcher
Summary: Something calls itself out of the air on the canyon road and asks whether you are worth the climb.

Name: q.ashen.well
DisplayName: What the Bandaged Thing Is Owed
Summary: A chain of trades down a dry well, each one paid for with something taken from the last.

Name: q.ashen.king
Summary: A king who refused to end his reign, holding court over a kingdom with nobody left in it.

Name: q.ashen.music
DisplayName: The Music That Holds the Dead
Summary: Music is what keeps the canyon standing. Find out who has been playing it, and for how long.

Name: q.moon.children
Summary: Five children in masks on the moon, each of whom would rather play a game than let you past.
